full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fashion photograph shows a woman seated on a city sidewalk beside a dark recessed doorway. The doorway and its strong vertical panels fill the right edge, while the left opens to a bright tree-lined street. The woman sits in the lower right half with her back close to the wall, her body angled toward the left and her face turned directly to the camera. Short tousled hair frames a pale face, and her chin rests on a hand supported by her elbow. She wears a strapless or bare-shouldered black dress with a full skirt spreading in a broad dark triangle across the pavement. One leg extends forward, ending in a dark heeled shoe near the lower left. A narrow pale arm and shoulder cut across the black fabric, forming the image's clearest tonal contrast. The sidewalk is lightly textured with seams and small marks; its lines lead toward the bright distance. At the far left, a tall streetlamp and cylindrical bin rise under leafy branches. Several people in the middle background appear as soft, bright silhouettes walking away, indistinct enough to keep attention on the seated figure. Daylight from the open street floods the left side and outlines hair, arm, and shoulder, while the doorway holds deep shade behind the dress. The camera is low at the woman's seated height, making the pose feel spontaneous despite the formal clothing. Grain and slight background blur preserve a candid film quality. No readable text appears. The overall composition is elegant and playful, balancing a large black skirt and doorway against luminous street space and a direct, thoughtful gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白时尚照片呈现一名女子坐在城市人行道上，身旁是深陷的暗门洞。门洞及强烈竖向门板填满右缘，左边则向明亮的林荫街道打开。女子坐在右下半部，背靠墙附近，身体斜向左，脸直接转向相机。短而凌乱的头发围住浅色面孔，下巴搭在由手肘支撑的手上。她穿露肩黑裙，宽大裙摆在铺地上展开成一块宽阔深色三角形。一条腿向前伸，深色高跟鞋落在左下附近。狭窄的浅色手臂与肩膀切过黑布，形成画面最清楚的明度对比。人行道带轻微纹理、接缝和细小痕迹；其线条引向明亮远方。最左侧，高路灯和圆筒垃圾箱立在树枝下。中部背景的几名行人化作柔焦浅色剪影向远处走去，模糊到不会与坐着的女子争夺注意。开阔街道的日光涌入左侧，勾亮头发、手臂和肩膀，门洞则在黑裙后留下深影。相机接近女子坐姿高度，使动作虽配正装也带偶然抓拍感。颗粒和轻微背景模糊保留胶片现场感。没有可读文字。整体构图优雅而俏皮，以大片黑裙和门洞平衡明亮街道空间与直接、若有所思的目光。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white fashion photograph places a sculptural dark garment against a bright candid street field. Strong vertical architectural lines steady a relaxed diagonal pose, while open pavement provides breathing room around the main silhouette. Pale skin and hair catch soft side light; matte black fabric absorbs it and becomes a broad clean shape. Background figures and foliage blur into light tonal patches, preserving urban atmosphere without competing detail. Film grain and low seated camera height make the polished styling feel immediate rather than sealed in a studio. Shadows remain deep beside the central form, but bright daylight keeps its contour crisp. The overall effect is chic and spontaneous, using contrast, posture, and street depth to hold the frame.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白时尚摄影把雕塑般深色织物置于明亮的抓拍街景前。强竖向建筑线稳住松散的斜向姿势，开放铺地给主要剪影留下呼吸空间。浅色皮肤和头发接住柔和侧光；哑光黑布吸收光，成为宽阔干净的形状。背景人物与枝叶模糊为浅调斑块，保留城市氛围而无竞争性细节。胶片颗粒和贴近坐姿的低机位让精心服装显得即时，而非封在影棚。中央形体旁阴影保持深暗，明亮日光仍使其轮廓清楚。整体效果时髦而自然，由对比、姿态和街道纵深稳住画面。

theme_zh: 一名黑裙女子坐在城市人行道上，身旁是深色门洞
